basic_info.description: Set in a coveted and historic neighborhood, a half a block to Dolores Park, this elegant home blends the best of graceful Edwardian detailing with contemporary updates for today's lifestyle. Spacious, warm and welcoming, this is a home for entertaining and gathering those close to you, a home for relaxing and a home for life. Classic and spacious living room withfireplace is flooded with light and looks out to stately trees. Grand dining and family room feature soaring ceilings, period details such as wainscoting and gorgeous built-in hutch, fireplaceand bespoke finishes. The large updated kitchen features stone countertops, premium appliances and ample cabinetry. Walk out to the large private and south facing deck with patio heater overlooking a gorgeous shared yard. Three large, full bedrooms and a remodeled bathroom offer a flexible floorplan and space to grow.Washer dryerand one car parking complete the home. Set in a treasured neighborhood on beautiful tree lined Cumberland street and just blocks from all the best dining, shopping and parks on Valencia Street, the Castro, Duboce Triangle, Noe Valley and the Mission with easy access to freeways, MUNI and BART, this special home is the one you have been waiting for.
